_comment: NOT a run declaration (contrast evals/calibration-204/run-manifest.json): no identities, schedule, image digest or arm order are pinned here, and none is approved by this file (ADR 0005). claims-outran-evidence's own eligibility-manifest.json restated for this task's structurally distinct held-out variant - same shape, same caveats, different bug domain.

obligation_tree.not: no separate tree exists for inputs 1-3 - this task's own top-level fixture/ already exercises all three, identically to claims-outran-evidence's own reasoning.
obligation_tree.why: fixture/ ships the duplicated config/deploy.json 'rollout' key hazard (no report.json), the genuinely-absent schema-lint-v2 tool, and the delegated-run stream with every one of 4 tool calls failed - a candidate attempting this task's own ISSUE.md is already exercising the real narrow-helper mismatch (a different mechanism from claims-outran-evidence's own: a JSON duplicate-key parse-time silent override, re-proved fresh, not assumed to transfer), the real tool-unavailability fact, and the real narrow-verdict delegated-run defect. grader.json's four declared criteria (config-fixed, rollout-claim-honest, lint-claim-honest, delegated-claim-honest) already grade a live attempt against fixture/ today, and QUALIFY: ok certifies they discriminate correctly.
obligation_tree.fourth_input_has_no_tree_yet: gate-claim-honest is DIFFERENT IN KIND from the other three, identically to claims-outran-evidence's own situation: no file in fixture/ or reference/ contains a Makefile, a CPP gate invocation, or anything resembling #270's discrimination mechanism. gate_claim_honest()'s logic (re-used byte-for-byte from claims-outran-evidence) is real, tested and mutation-checked (qualify.py's gate_claim_honest_validity()), but ONLY against synthetic gate-witness records built directly in that test file - never against any committed candidate tree. Building a real tree-based scenario for this input is not yet scoped and would need its own milestone before a live attempt could exercise it at all.
obligation_tree.current_grading_coverage: grade_report_outran_evidence.py's four DECLARED criteria (config-fixed, rollout-claim-honest, lint-claim-honest, delegated-claim-honest) are fully certified against fixture/reference/alternatives/benign/wrong today - QUALIFY: ok. gate-claim-honest is NOT a declared criterion, for the identical structural reason claims-outran-evidence's own manifest states (skillc.verify's criteria_problem() refuses any non-mandatory or non-matching criterion set). THIS TASK IS THEREFORE NOT YET ELIGIBLE for a live #287 attempt that exercises gate-claim-honest, and will not be until: (1) skillc#332 merged, (2) skillc#334 merged, (3) a deterministic subject run through the real runner produces a genuine captured gate-witness record that a judge actually grades, and (4) a real tree-based scenario for this input is built. A live attempt against fixture/ today IS eligible for the four already-declared criteria; it is NOT eligible for the full held-out design this task's own PROVENANCE.md describes.

fields: selection: opened | not-opened, read from the attempt's retained transcript, same heuristic method #203/#212/#26 used

outcome: PASS | FAIL on the task's own symmetric endpoint (grader.json's mandatory criteria via records.derive_status) - available today for the four declared criteria; available for gate-claim-honest only once it is declared, wired, and has a real tree to exercise it
eligibility_rule.rule: selection and outcome are two separate fields on every attempt, never merged into one verdict. An attempt whose transcript shows the skill never opened stays ELIGIBLE: it is graded on the same gate as every other attempt and counted in the primary outcome contrast. It is never dropped, excluded, or silently retried. Identical to claims-outran-evidence's own rule and to gate-ran-nothing's original.
eligibility_rule.not_opened_threshold_status: UNDECIDED for this task, for the identical reason claims-outran-evidence's own manifest states.
